concerns.text: The plan validates the lightweight‑agent performance on the *inferred‑subset* (tasks where ground‑truth intents are missing) by scoring against the same inferred intents that were used to build the Intent Graph (see Phase 5 – Statistical Validation, step 5.2 “repeat scoring on tasks where inferred intents have confidence ≥ 0.8”). This makes the validation target (the inferred intent labels) *definitionally dependent* on the predictor (the Intent Graph nodes), creating a circular/tautological evaluation that cannot demonstrate genuine predictive power.
